explore-absorb.title: Escape the D region
explore-absorb.prompt: Step up through the bands until a sky wave gets through at midday.
explore-absorb.success: 40 m gets past the D region; 160 m and 80 m are soaked up in daylight.

explore-night.title: Wait for dark
explore-night.prompt: Change the time until 160 m comes back.
explore-night.success: After dark the D region disappears, and 160 m reaches far again.
